[EN] Rhodos has granted you sanctuary, outsider. I shall extend you the courtesy of my tutelage.

Don't let my staff fool you, though. I do not taint myself with blood magic.
[ES] Rhodos te ha concedido refugio, forastero. Te extenderé la cortesía de mi enseñanza.

Sin embargo, no dejes que mi bastón te engañe. No me mancho con magia de sangre.
